rule: SPEC_RE_BPMN_JS_PARITY.md §8.5: an upstream (reference) bug is recorded as a deviation entry with its source path:line, never reproduced silently. A scenario backed by an entry is excluded from its gate with verdict `deviation`: the harness still runs it, compares both runs up to the triggering op (`op`), and requires that op to reproduce the recorded symptom in both runs; if the upstream behaviour changes, the gate command fails.

entries.summary: the FloatingEdges example's custom connection line crashes on any connection drag with @xyflow/react 12.12.0: it builds the connection target as a plain node without `internals` and passes it to a helper that reads `internals.positionAbsolute`

sources.note: targetNode built with id/width/height/position only (no internals), cast to InternalNode
targetNode.internals.positionAbsolute: TypeError on the connection target

entries.trigger: a connection drag from a node handle (pointer op connect)
entries.effect: the error is thrown during render; React unmounts the example tree, so no graph remains to compare
